 Order

When the matter was taken up for hearing on 19.10.2023, it was informed by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner died and therefore, in order to get instructions and to file application for substituting the legal heirs in the place of deceased petitioner, he sought some time.
Even today, the learned counsel for the petitioner has not received any information to substitute the legal representatives.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 2.In view of the same
, the writ petition stands dismissed as abated.
As and when the legal representatives approach the learned counsel for the petitioner, a petition to set aside the abatement and restoration petition can be filed.
No costs.
By virtue of order passed in W.P(MD)No.17088 of 2020, WMP(MD)No.23045 of 2023 is closed.
